title: In-process subagent execution, OpenCode-style nested chat, delegation tools, and reactive tool matrix
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer & react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Implemented OpenCode-style subagent execution: runs in-process inside parent active worktree with zero separate worktrees and zero card movement. Added collect_subagent with batch array support and zero-context-pollution on subagent failure. Added subagent cards, nested chat view with breadcrumbs, and hierarchical subagent master/slave toggles in Tool Policy Matrix.
